cases.title: A moving track matte with its eye off is taught like any layer, not called hidden

rubric.reason: Wipe is never called hidden, off or left out: the opening lists only Rig and Draft as hidden, and Turn 2 teaches Wipe like any other layer ("From 0.6 s to 1.6 s Wipe's Position moves at one speed the whole way… Ease Wipe's Position move from 0.6 s to 1.6 s and say done").

Wipe is never called hidden, off or left out, and is never grouped with Rig and Draft (Turn 1's leave-out list names only Rig, Draft, the precomps and Gauge Dial); in Turn 2 it is taught like any layer: "From 0.6 s to 1.6 s, Wipe's Position moves at one speed the whole way… Ease Wipe's Position move from 0.6 s to 1.6 s and say done."

Turn 1 lists only Rig and Draft as hidden, and Turn 2 teaches Wipe like any other layer ("From 0.6 s to 1.6 s Wipe's Position moves at one speed the whole way… Ease Wipe's Position from 0.6 s to 1.6 s and say done"); it never calls Wipe hidden, off or invisible, even though preview_frame returned layer_bounds_reason "not_rendered".
